groups.label: Shield Wall (Nebuloch swap)
groups.countReason: two walls (Shield Wall's 'Limit 2 active Shield Walls', gem lookup) raised from weapon set 2 and shattered together by one Seismic Cry: two hits land, but only the top bleed applies (one bleed per enemy; the brainstorm gate's interview, interviews/brainstorm-1.md), which the record's Count rule follows by counting the hit twice and the bleed once

boss.note: Rake the boss on weapon set 1 to bleed, poison and prime it for stun, then swap to Nebuloch's set: raise two Shield Walls beside the boss, each spending a held Endurance Charge to crit, and shatter both with Seismic Cry, which heavy-stuns a primed boss (Enduring Impact II's 3 charges, Cranial Impact's 1, each doubled by Serpent's Egg, up to the cap of 3) for the next pair. The shatter is two crit hits at 140% more and one bleed, aggravated by The Smiling Knight; Rake's poison from before the swap keeps the boss poisoned for Admixture; swap back and Rake in the gaps while the cry's 8 s cooldown runs. One bleed per enemy, only the top one deals damage: the walls' bleed while it runs, Rake's in the gaps, never the sum. On this rung the charges come only from heavy stuns, so the first pair may land without a crit

earned.uptime: map packs walk and run at you while Rake's bleed ticks on them, so most of a bleed counts as moving (an estimate); a pack that stops loses the extra 100% unless Herald of Blood's aggravation lands; on a standing boss the same 100% comes from aggravation, The Smiling Knight's on each crit wall

Rake inflicts Bleeding on every hit, so a target Rake struck is bleeding when its poison and the Heralds' explosions land; it turns on Poison III's and Admixture's 20% more poison against bleeding enemies

PoB's PoisonChancePerHit for Rake is 60% on m and b and 76% on n (Poison III, and on n Deterioration's ailment-chance passives), a flat chance rather than a buildup, so a boss meets the same chance; Rake's poison lasts about 1.9 s against about 1.1 s between uses, so a target Rake keeps hitting is poisoned at most of its hits (60 to 76% of them, an estimate), and packs stay poisoned through Herald of Blood's poisoning explosions and Herald of Plague's spread; it turns on Admixture's 20% more bleed on Rake against poisoned enemies

on this rung, with no anoint, the charges come from heavy stuns: Seismic Cry heavy-stunning a primed boss grants Enduring Impact II's 3 and Cranial Impact's 1, each doubled by Serpent's Egg, capped at 3; PoB gives an Endurance Charge no effect of its own on set 1, and on set 2 Nebuloch's drain runs per charge held
two charges at the swap, one per wall, after a heavy stun; Nebuloch's 100 chaos damage a second per charge runs on set 2 until the walls spend them
Brutality III's 20% chance per hit to ignore physical damage reduction on the walls, averaged over hits as PoB does by default

3 Rage per melee hit on each enemy struck (Bestial Rage and its two Rage on Hit small passives), so the 30 cap fills in a pack's first strikes and holds while you keep hitting; it starts draining 4 s after the last hit (BaseRageLossDelayMs 4000), so a long walk between packs restarts it

It assumes a charge held for each wall; on this rung, with no anoint, the charges come from heavy stuns (Seismic Cry with Enduring Impact II, Cranial Impact, doubled by Serpent's Egg), so the first pair of a fight may land plain; set 2's Herald explosions would spend charges too in game, which the line leaves out

Rake's own 'Deals up to 130% more Damage, based on the distance travelled' (100% plus 30% from 20% quality; gem lookup 'Rake'), which PoB applies none of: its stat map names base_dash_additional_damage_from_distance_+%_final while the gem carries base_additional_damage_from_distance_+%_final (Data/Skills/act_dex.lua:6428-6442; the card's skill-shape probe, check 8). Worked out on PoB's own ramp for the line, full at 50 units (5 m, the dash's base_melee_dash_range 50), at PoB's default enemy distance of 20 units (Modules/ConfigOptions.lua:1621): 20/50 x 130% = 52%. A dash from further pays up to 130%, one from beside the enemy nothing

claims.text: Act 2, Valley of the Titans, the Medallion: take 30% increased Charm Charges Gained with its +1 Charm Slot; both options give the slot, and the faster charges keep the charms going through a map.
Act 3, Venom Crypts, the Venom Draught: take 25% increased Stun Threshold, for a melee build that stands in the pack; the mana regeneration option does nothing once Blood Magic leaves no mana.

Act 4, Eye of Hinekora, Tribal Medicine: take 30% increased Global Armour, Evasion and Energy Shield, more of the armour the hardest physical hits meet; the other option's deflection and energy shield parts give this armour build nothing.
Act 4, Halls of the Dead, Tawhoa's Test: take +5% to Lightning Resistance over +5 Dexterity, toward the capped resistances the endgame needs.
Act 4, Halls of the Dead, Tasalio's Test: take +5% to Cold Resistance over +5 Intelligence, which no gem or item here needs.
Act 4, Halls of the Dead, Ngamahu's Test: take +5% to Fire Resistance over +5 Strength, toward the capped resistances the endgame needs.

Act 4, Abandoned Prison, the Goddess of Justice: take 30% increased Life Recovery from Flasks; neither option helps much here, since Blood Magic leaves no mana and Vaal Pact (see the gloves' trap) recovers life from leech alone, and the life option serves a player who later drops Atziri's Acuity.
Interlude 2, Qimah, the Seven Pillars: take +5% to all Elemental Resistances, the most resistance any option gives, toward the capped resistances the endgame needs.

The shatter is two crit hits at 140% more and one bleed, aggravated by The Smiling Knight; Rake's poison from before the swap keeps the boss poisoned for Admixture; swap back and Rake in the gaps while the cry's 8 s cooldown runs, pressing the cry only off cooldown so its bypass spends no charge. One bleed per enemy, only the top one deals damage: the walls' bleed while it runs, Rake's in the gaps, never the sum
